rows.fact: The flux of a carrier is a constant of the tick and the position of a quantum is not, so no symmetry of the tick exchanges the two labels. Four further exact mismatches (below). The label groups are dual in two ways, as for any Z6 register. C needs one declared gate and option M1.

Equal population per state fails by at least 52 standard errors in every class (produced shares) and by 378 (stationary densities); 4 of the 32 states have no defect. The densities are remnants of the quench, so a count confirms no reading.

Addition modulo 6 is the rule of the register and holds for any labels. 52.3 percent of the events join two defects into one or split one into two, which three fermions cannot do. Class 3 is its own conjugate; the lepton doublet is not.

Three classes cannot move; two diffuse with no ballistic stretch and die out. A defect answers a load flow sideways, with the sign of its class; no drift along the gradient or toward its conjugate is resolved. In A the quanta travel on the cone with mean free paths 10.4, 12.0, 123 carriers and none. In C the composite travels by one declared gate.
The classes of a carrier sum to zero modulo 6 in every history: an identity of the register. Flux conservation (A) and neutral composites (B) restate it. It does not discriminate.

D_flux_attachment.statement: on a surface a charge q bound to a flux k gains the exchange phase exp(2 pi i q k/6); it is -1 only for odd q with flux 3 or q = 3 with odd flux.
